process_area.title: Corporate Development Strategy, Pipeline & Target Identification

value_stream.name: Corporate Development, Mergers & Acquisitions, Divestiture & Strategic Transactions

fields.Participants: Corp Dev, Strategy (links to VS-33), Finance/Treasury (links to VS-17.4/VS-18), Board (links to VS-36), business-unit leaders, Legal (links to VS-100)
fields.Trigger: Annual strategy (links to VS-33.1); board direction; capital plan

workflows.name: Corporate Development & Growth Strategy, Portfolio & Capital Allocation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "Corp Dev/Strategy define the corporate-development strategy aligned to enterprise" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "approve the corporate-development mandate and budget, and set decision…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-620 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Development Strategy, Pipeline & Target Identification (PA-130.1).)
- operational: strategy-first mandate; operational: capital-allocation framework
Pain Points / Risks: - **Strategy-misalignment risk**: Deals pursued opportunistically without strategic anchor; mitigated by strategy-first mandate
- **Capital-overcommitment risk**: M&A crowding out operations; mitigated by capital-allocation framework
System Touchpoints: - Strategy (links to VS-33); finance/treasury (links to VS-17.4/VS-18); governance (links to VS-36); consolidation (links to VS-72)

steps.activity: Corp Dev/Strategy define the corporate-development strategy aligned to enterprise strategy (links to VS-33.1): growth objectives (geographic — new Philippine regions; capability — installation/design/B2B/digital/fintech; category — adjacencies), portfolio lens (which businesses/categories to grow/hold/divest), and the role of M&A/JV vs organic (links to VS-37)

Corp Dev/Finance establish the capital-allocation framework for transactions: capex vs M&A vs shareholder returns, financing capacity (cash, debt links to VS-18, equity), risk appetite, and the impact on the 5-entity structure and consolidation (links to VS-72)
CEO/Board ratify the strategy, approve the corporate-development mandate and budget, and set decision rights/governance (links to W3983)

fields.Participants: Corp Dev, Strategy (links to VS-33.3), Insights (links to VS-44), Finance (links to VS-17.4), affected business unit, Legal (links to VS-100), Govt Affairs (links to VS-104)
fields.Trigger: Growth opportunity; capability gap; market-entry decision

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "document the recommendation, seek approval" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-620 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Development Strategy, Pipeline & Target Identification (PA-130.1).)
- operational: structured framework; operational: regulatory and competitive analysis
Pain Points / Risks: - **Bias-to-buy risk**: Defaulting to acquisition when build/partner is better; mitigated by structured framework
- **Market-entry-misread risk**: Wrong mode for the market; mitigated by regulatory and competitive analysis
System Touchpoints: - Strategy/insights (links to VS-33.3/VS-44); legal (links to VS-100); competition (links to VS-129); govt affairs (links to VS-104)

steps.activity: Corp Dev/Strategy apply the build-vs-buy-vs-partner framework to each growth opportunity: organic build (store opening VS-37, capability build VS-123), acquisition (VS-130), JV/strategic alliance (links to W3963), licensing/franchise, or marketplace/3P extension (VS-95) — scoring on time-to-market, capability fit, cost, risk, and control

Corp Dev assess market-entry mode for new geographies/categories (greenfield vs acquisition vs JV), regulatory/foreign-ownership considerations (links to VS-104/VS-87), and competitive/antitrust implications (links to VS-129 W3963/W3967)
Corp Dev document the recommendation, seek approval (links to W3983), and route to the appropriate execution path

fields.Participants: Corp Dev, Strategy (links to VS-33.3), Insights (links to VS-44), business units, external advisors/bankers, Legal (links to VS-100)
fields.Trigger: Strategy mandate; market scan; inbound approach

workflows.name: Acquisition Target Sourcing, Pipeline & Deal Origination

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "report to the CEO/Board" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-620 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Development Strategy, Pipeline & Target Identification (PA-130.1).)
- operational: active market mapping; operational: ABC screening
Pain Points / Risks: - **Narrow-pipeline risk**: Few alternatives reduce negotiating leverage; mitigated by active market mapping
- **ABC exposure risk**: Target/principal integrity issues; mitigated by ABC screening
System Touchpoints: - Strategy/insights (links to VS-33.3/VS-44); legal/NDAs (links to VS-100); ABC (links to VS-86/VS-119); governance (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Corp Dev maintain the acquisition/JV pipeline: market mapping of targets (competitor chains, regional banners, specialty retailers, service/installation/design businesses, digital/fintech adjacencies), sourcing channels (direct, advisors/bankers, industry networks), and inbound-offer triage

Corp Dev build relationships with target owners/principals (many are privately/family-held like BuildRight), assess readiness and willingness, and manage confidentiality/NDAs (links to VS-100) and any ABC screening (links to VS-86/VS-119)
Corp Dev prioritize the pipeline against strategy/capacity, refresh regularly, and report to the CEO/Board (links to VS-36)

fields.Participants: Corp Dev, Strategy, Insights (links to VS-44), Finance (links to VS-17.4), affected business unit, Legal (links to VS-100), HR (links to VS-19/VS-84), Tax (links to VS-79)

workflows.name: Target Screening, Strategic Fit & Preliminary Assessment

Automation Opportunity: - System rule-based authorization of "Corp Dev conduct the preliminary strategic-fit and business assessment" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-flag of "Corp Dev/Finance conduct a preliminary financial screen" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-generate of "prepare the LOI/term-sheet groundwork" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-620 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Development Strategy, Pipeline & Target Identification (PA-130.1).)
- operational: disciplined screen and value range; operational: red-flag screen
Pain Points / Risks: - **Overpayment-setup risk**: Thin screen leading to inflated price; mitigated by disciplined screen and value range
- **Hidden risk**: Material issues missed pre-LOI; mitigated by red-flag screen
System Touchpoints: - Strategy/insights (links to VS-33.3/VS-44); finance (links to VS-17.4); legal (links to VS-100); HR (links to VS-19/VS-84); tax (links to VS-79)

steps.activity: Corp Dev conduct the preliminary strategic-fit and business assessment using public/authorized information: market position, store/portfolio overlap, assortment and channel fit, customer base, brand, operations, and high-level synergies

Corp Dev/Finance conduct a preliminary financial screen: revenue, EBITDA/margin, growth, capital structure, and a preliminary value range; Corp Dev/Legal/HR screen red flags (legal, labor/union, tax, ABC, ESG)
steps.r: Corp Dev / Finance / Legal / HR / Tax

steps.activity: Corp Dev recommend go/no-go to the stage-gate (links to W3983), and if go, prepare the LOI/term-sheet groundwork (links to W3982)

fields.Participants: Corp Dev, Finance (links to VS-17.4), Treasury (links to VS-18), Tax (links to VS-79), Strategy, external valuation advisors, affected business unit

Automation Opportunity: - workflow automation; system-driven processing with exception handling
Controls: - CTL-620 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Development Strategy, Pipeline & Target Identification (PA-130.1).)
- operational: conservative base case and sensitivity analysis; operational: treasury involvement
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-optimism risk**: Synergies/returns overstated; mitigated by conservative base case and sensitivity analysis
- **Financing risk**: Deal un-fundable or covenant-breaching; mitigated by treasury involvement
System Touchpoints: - Finance (links to VS-17.4); treasury (links to VS-18); tax (links to VS-79); capex accounting (links to VS-40); analytics (links to VS-28)

steps.activity: Corp Dev/Finance build the deal financial model: standalone financials (revenue, EBITDA, FCF), synergy cases (revenue/cost/financial), integration cost, financing structure, and returns (NPV/IRR/payback/ROIC) consistent with BuildRight's standards (links to VS-40/VS-17.4)

Corp Dev/external-advisors determine valuation using multiple methods (DCF, trading comps, transaction comps, asset-based) and establish the offer range and walk-away price; assess financing mix (cash, debt links to VS-18, equity) and covenant/liquidity impact
CFO/Corp-Dev present the valuation and financing plan to the approval authority (links to W3983), and set the negotiation envelope (links to W3982)

fields.Owner: Head of Corporate Development / VP Legal
fields.Participants: Corp Dev, Legal (links to VS-100), Finance/Treasury, Tax (links to VS-79), HR (links to VS-19), Strategy, CEO, external counsel/advisors

workflows.name: Deal Structuring, Term Sheet & Letter of Intent (LOI) Negotiation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "report progress to the approval authority" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-620 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Development Strategy, Pipeline & Target Identification (PA-130.1).)
- operational: tax/legal structuring; operational: time-boxed exclusivity
Pain Points / Risks: - **Structuring-suboptimal risk**: Asset/share/consideration choice increasing tax/legal cost; mitigated by tax/legal structuring
- **Exclusivity-abuse risk**: Long exclusivity without progress; mitigated by time-boxed exclusivity
System Touchpoints: - Legal (links to VS-100); tax (links to VS-79); treasury (links to VS-18); HR (links to VS-19); competition (links to VS-129 W3967)

steps.activity: Corp Dev/Legal structure the transaction: asset vs share purchase, entity/legal structure (within the 5-entity group or new entity), consideration (cash/deferred/earn-out/equity), working-capital mechanism, retention/escrow, reps & warranties, indemnities, conditions precedent, and exclusivity/confidentiality

Corp Dev/Legal negotiate and execute the LOI/term sheet (non-binding except for exclusivity/confidentiality), managing the target/sellers and advisors, and preserving competition-clearance and regulatory gates (links to W3967/W3983)
Corp Dev set up confirmatory due diligence (links to PA-130.2) and SPA negotiation (links to W3991), and report progress to the approval authority (links to W3983)

fields.Participants: CEO, Board/Audit Committee (links to VS-36), CFO, Head of Corp Dev, VP Legal, affected business unit

workflows.name: M&A Governance, Approval Authority & Stage-Gate Process

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "documentation, and the approval-authority matrix by deal size" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "review material transactions" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "file and audit trail" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: stage-gate and authority matrix; operational: covenant review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Approval-bypass risk**: Binding commitments made without authority; mitigated by stage-gate and authority matrix
- **Covenant-breach risk**: Deal not disclosed to lenders; mitigated by covenant review
System Touchpoints: - Governance (links to VS-36); legal/records (links to VS-100/VS-88); audit (links to VS-21); treasury/covenants (links to VS-18)

steps.activity: Corp Dev/CEO operate the stage-gate process: defined gates (strategy, screen, valuation, LOI, DD, SPA, close, integration), decision criteria, documentation, and the approval-authority matrix by deal size (CEO → Board → shareholders) tied to BuildRight's authority matrix (links to VS-36 governance)

Board/Audit-Committee review material transactions (strategic fit, valuation, risks, financing, competition clearance links to W3967, integration plan links to PA-130.3) and approve/decline at each binding gate
Corp Dev/Legal document decisions, maintain the deal file and audit trail (links to VS-88/VS-21), and ensure disclosure to debt-holders/lenders where covenants require (links to VS-18)

fields.Participants: Corp Dev (deal lead), Legal, Finance, Tax, HR, IT, affected business unit, Strategy, Integration Lead, external advisors, PMO (links to VS-112)

workflows.name: M&A Project Setup, Deal Team & Deal Management Office

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "Corp Dev stand up the deal team and deal" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "log, budget, info-barrier/clean-team protocols" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track milestones and risks to close, and transition to integration" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-620 (ensure controlled execution — Corporate Development Strategy, Pipeline & Target Identification (PA-130.1).)
- operational: DMO and PMO discipline; operational: clean-team and comms controls
Pain Points / Risks: - **Disorganization risk**: Missed milestones/tasks; mitigated by DMO and PMO discipline
- **Leak/confidentiality risk**: Premature disclosure; mitigated by clean-team and comms controls
System Touchpoints: - PMO (links to VS-112); legal/records (links to VS-100/VS-88); comms (links to VS-14.3/VS-103.1); competition (links to VS-129)

steps.activity: Corp Dev stand up the deal team and deal management office (DMO): deal lead, workstream leads (legal, finance, tax, HR, IT, commercial, integration), external advisors, RACI, cadence, deal room/data room, and reporting (leveraging PMO discipline links to VS-112)

Corp Dev establish the deal plan and controls: timeline, milestones, workstream plans, risk log, budget, info-barrier/clean-team protocols (links to VS-129), and communications plan (internal links to VS-103.1; external links to VS-14.3)
Corp Dev run the deal cadence, track milestones and risks to close, and transition to integration (links to PA-130.3)
